_comment: Scripted LLM rules for the services E2E. The provider's Tier-1 eta_query instruction contains 'Route 42', so the first rule matches and returns a schema-valid ETA JSON directly (no tool call → the agentic loop terminates on the first turn). The empty-match fallback keeps any other agentic call (e.g. a stray classify) deterministic.

rules.content: {"status":"on_route","eta_minutes":7,"route_name":"Route 42","vehicle_type":"Bus","stop_name":"Castro","stop_distance_m":1450,"message":"Route 42 is on route. The next bus reaches Castro in about 7 minutes."}
